verses.text: Elihu went on speaking:
"Be patient with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to say for God.
I will gather my knowledge from far and wide, and I will show that my Maker is right.
Be sure that my words are not false. Someone with complete knowledge is here with you.
God is mighty, but he does not look down on anyone. He is mighty and firm in his purpose.
He does not keep evil people alive, but he gives justice to those who suffer.
He does not take his eyes off good people. He seats them on thrones with kings and lifts them up forever.
But if people are bound in chains, caught in the ropes of suffering,
he shows them what they have done, how they have sinned in their pride.
He makes them listen to his correction and commands them to turn away from evil.
If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in wealth and their years in happiness.
But if they do not obey, they will die by the sword. They will die without knowledge.
Godless people hold on to their anger. Even when God chains them, they do not cry for help.
They die while they are young, among the shameful people at the shrines.
But God rescues those who suffer through their suffering. He speaks to them in their troubles.
He wanted to lead you out of trouble into a wide-open place, free from limits, to a table full of the best food.
But now you are full of the judgment the wicked deserve. Judgment and justice have taken hold of you.
Be careful that wealth does not lead you into anger. Do not let a large bribe turn you aside.
Will your riches or all your great strength help you when trouble comes?
Do not long for the night, when people are taken away from their homes.
Be careful not to turn to evil, because that seems to be what you would choose instead of suffering.
Look, God is great in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Who has told him what to do? Who can say to him, 'You have done wrong'?
Remember to praise what he has done, which people have sung about.
Everyone has seen it. People look at it from far away.
Yes, God is great, beyond our understanding. No one can count the number of his years.
He draws up drops of water and turns them into rain from the mist.
The clouds pour down the rain, and it falls on people in showers.
Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, or the thunder that comes from where he lives?
Look how he spreads his lightning around him and covers the bottom of the sea.
This is how he rules the nations and gives them plenty of food.
He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to hit its target.
His thunder tells of his coming. Even the cattle know a storm is on its way.
